title: Warm the same rod more
hook: Change temperature change and predict length change.
misconception: length change stays fixed when temperature change doubles.
objective: Apply ΔL = αL₀ΔT to compare length change when temperature change changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With the same rod and linear expansion coefficient over a limited temperature range, ΔL = αL₀ΔT. When temperature change doubles, length change becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model ΔL = αL₀ΔT; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider the same rod and linear expansion coefficient over a limited temperature range, with a nonzero initial result. If temperature change triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on length change?
recall.why: Apply ΔL = αL₀ΔT under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
